name: Greek Words 201–300
description: Common Greek nouns, pronouns, adjectives and adverbs, numbers 201–300 on the frequency list. Nouns come with their article, plural and genitive; adjectives with their feminine and neuter forms.

cards.definition: Weighing a lot; also hard to digest.
cards.notes: Opposite: ελαφρύς.

cards.definition: Not heavy.

examples.translation: I want something light for dinner.

cards.notes: Also spelled ελαφρός. Opposite: βαρύς.

cards.definition: Moving or happening at high speed.

examples.text: Το ίντερνετ εδώ είναι πολύ γρήγορο.
examples.translation: The internet here is very fast.

cards.notes: Adverb: γρήγορα = quickly. Γρήγορα! = Hurry up!

cards.definition: Taking a long time; not fast.

examples.text: Το λεωφορείο είναι πιο αργό από το μετρό.
examples.translation: The bus is slower than the metro.

cards.notes: Adverb: αργά = slowly; also late.

cards.definition: Having a lot of money; having a lot of something.
cards.notes: Opposite: φτωχός.

cards.definition: Having little money.

examples.translation: He grew up in a poor village.

cards.definition: Feeling or showing deep happiness.
cards.notes: Χρόνια πολλά και ευτυχισμένα! = Many happy returns!

cards.definition: Unhappy.
cards.notes: Λυπάμαι = I'm sorry.

cards.definition: Full of joy; pleased.
cards.notes: Η χαρά = joy. Χαίρομαι = I'm glad.

cards.definition: Feeling anger.
cards.notes: Ο θυμός = anger. Θυμώνω = to get angry.

cards.definition: Needing rest.
cards.notes: Κουράζομαι = to get tired.

cards.definition: Not well; having an illness.

examples.translation: I'm ill so I'm staying at home.

examples.text: Το παιδί είναι άρρωστο από χθες.
examples.translation: The child has been ill since yesterday.

cards.notes: Η αρρώστια = illness. Αρρωσταίνω = to fall ill.

cards.definition: Prepared to do something or be used.
cards.notes: Ετοιμάζω = to prepare.

cards.definition: Having no doubt; free from danger.

examples.text: Δεν είμαι σίγουρη ότι θα έρθει.

cards.notes: Σίγουρα! = Certainly! / Sure!

cards.definition: Belonging to a particular person.
cards.notes: Δικός μου / σου / του = mine / yours / his.

cards.definition: Just made or bought; not used before.
cards.notes: Also spelled καινούργιος. Νέος also means new, but καινούριος is the usual word for brand-new things.

cards.definition: Not the same.

examples.text: Τα δύο αδέρφια είναι πολύ διαφορετικά.
examples.translation: The two siblings are very different.

cards.notes: Διαφορετικός από = different from.

cards.definition: Kind and pleasant to others.

examples.text: Οι άνθρωποι εδώ είναι πολύ φιλικοί.
examples.translation: The people here are very friendly.

cards.definition: At or to a short distance.

examples.text: Είναι κοντά; Πάμε με τα πόδια.

cards.notes: Κοντά σε = near: κοντά στο σπίτι. Opposite: μακριά.

cards.definition: At or to a great distance.

examples.translation: Do you live far from here?

cards.notes: Μακριά από = far from. Opposite: κοντά.

cards.definition: Not inside; out of a place.

examples.text: Περίμενέ με έξω από το σινεμά.
examples.translation: Wait for me outside the cinema.

cards.notes: Έξω από = outside (of). Στο εξωτερικό = abroad.

cards.definition: In the position facing forwards.

examples.translation: I'll wait for you in front of the cinema.
Sit in the front, next to me.

cards.notes: Μπροστά σε / από = in front of. Opposite: πίσω.

cards.definition: At the back; to an earlier place.

examples.text: Ο κήπος είναι πίσω από το σπίτι.
examples.translation: The garden is behind the house.

examples.text: Θα γυρίσω πίσω σε μία ώρα.
examples.translation: I'll be back in an hour.

cards.notes: Πίσω από = behind. Opposite: μπροστά.

cards.definition: At the side of something.
cards.notes: Δίπλα σε = next to: δίπλα στην πόρτα.

cards.definition: On every side; in a circle.

examples.text: Υπάρχουν πολλά μαγαζιά γύρω από την πλατεία.
examples.translation: There are lots of shops around the square.

cards.notes: Γύρω από = around. With numbers: γύρω στα πενήντα = about fifty.

cards.definition: On or to the right-hand side.

examples.translation: Turn right at the traffic lights.
The bank is on the right.

cards.notes: Opposite: αριστερά. Adjective: δεξιός.

cards.definition: On or to the left-hand side.

examples.translation: The toilet is on the left.
Take the first road on the left.

cards.notes: Opposite: δεξιά. In politics, η αριστερά = the Left.

cards.definition: Whatever else is true.

examples.text: Δεν ξέρω για τους άλλους, εγώ πάντως θα έρθω.
examples.translation: I don't know about the others, but I'll come anyway.

cards.definition: Possibly.
Most likely.

examples.translation: I'll probably be a bit late.

cards.notes: Μάλλον… παρά… = rather… than….

cards.definition: Very close to, but not completely.

examples.text: Πάμε για κολύμπι σχεδόν κάθε μέρα.
examples.translation: We go swimming almost every day.

cards.definition: A very short time ago; at the moment when.

examples.translation: Call me as soon as you arrive.

cards.notes: Also "barely": μόλις που το είδα = I barely saw it.

cards.definition: Quickly and without warning.
Without any delay.

examples.text: Θα σας φέρω τον λογαριασμό αμέσως.
examples.translation: I'll bring you the bill right away.

cards.definition: In most cases.

examples.translation: I usually wake up at seven.
What do you usually do at the weekend?

cards.notes: Η συνήθεια = habit.

cards.definition: Many times.
cards.notes: Πόσο συχνά; = How often?

cards.definition: One more time.

examples.text: Θέλω να έρθω ξανά στην Ελλάδα.
examples.translation: I want to come to Greece again.

cards.notes: Same meaning as πάλι.

cards.definition: On this day.
On the day after today.

examples.translation: I have a lesson tomorrow morning.

cards.notes: Μεθαύριο = the day after tomorrow.

cards.definition: On the day before today.

examples.translation: Yesterday we went to the cinema.

cards.notes: Also spelled χτες. Προχθές = the day before yesterday.

cards.definition: During the current year.

examples.text: Φέτος θα πάμε διακοπές στην Κρήτη.
examples.translation: This year we're going on holiday to Crete.

examples.text: Φέτος ο χειμώνας είναι πολύ κρύος.
examples.translation: The winter is very cold this year.

cards.notes: Πέρσι = last year; του χρόνου = next year.

cards.definition: Before the usual or expected time.
cards.notes: Opposite: αργά.

cards.definition: After the usual time; not quickly.
cards.notes: Αργώ = to be late. Opposite: νωρίς (early) or γρήγορα (quickly).

cards.definition: Before now, or sooner than expected.
cards.notes: More colloquial: κιόλας.

cards.definition: If not; in another way.

examples.text: Βιάσου, αλλιώς θα χάσουμε το τρένο.
examples.translation: Hurry, otherwise we'll miss the train.

cards.definition: In addition; in the same way.

examples.translation: She speaks Greek and also French.

cards.notes: Επίσης! as a reply = Same to you!

cards.definition: Without other people; the only one.

examples.text: Είναι το μόνο παιδί της οικογένειας.
examples.translation: He's the only child in the family.

cards.notes: Μόνος μου / σου… = by myself / yourself…: Το έφτιαξα μόνος μου = I made it myself.

cards.translation: in the end, finally; after all
cards.definition: After everything; as it turned out.

examples.translation: In the end he didn't come.

cards.definition: In fact; very.
cards.notes: Adjective: πραγματικός = real.

cards.definition: Only; in a simple way.

examples.translation: I just wanted to see you.

cards.notes: Also απλώς (simply, just). Adjective: απλός.

cards.definition: More than usual; for a particular purpose.

examples.text: Μου αρέσουν τα φρούτα, ειδικά τα κεράσια.

examples.translation: I made it specially for you.

cards.definition: To a greater degree than others.

examples.text: Μου άρεσε ιδιαίτερα το τέλος της ταινίας.
examples.translation: I particularly liked the end of the film.

cards.definition: For the most part.

examples.translation: In summer it's mainly tourists who come.

cards.definition: Used to explain or check what was meant.

examples.text: Θα έρθω σε δύο μέρες, δηλαδή την Πέμπτη.
examples.translation: I'll come in two days, that is, on Thursday.

cards.definition: Compared with others; on the subject of.

examples.text: Θέλω να σου μιλήσω σχετικά με το ταξίδι.
examples.translation: I want to talk to you about the trip.

cards.notes: Σχετικά με = about, regarding.

cards.definition: In most cases; overall.

examples.translation: On the whole, I like Athens.
In general I wake up early.

cards.definition: On the other side; facing.

examples.translation: The pharmacy is across the street.

cards.notes: Απέναντι από = opposite.

cards.definition: At the side of.

examples.translation: We were walking side by side.

cards.notes: Same meaning as δίπλα. Πλάι πλάι = side by side.

cards.definition: A thought or plan.
Something you think; the act of thinking.

examples.translation: I'm thinking it over. (literally "I'm in thoughts")

cards.notes: Σκέφτομαι = to think.

cards.definition: What you think about something.
cards.notes: Κατά τη γνώμη μου = in my opinion.

cards.definition: What you say or write back to a question or message.
Something you ask.
cards.notes: Κάνω μια ερώτηση = to ask a question.

cards.definition: A way of solving a problem.
How something is done.
cards.notes: Οι τρόποι = manners. Με κάθε τρόπο = by all means.

cards.definition: A very short period of time.

examples.text: Ήταν η καλύτερη στιγμή της ζωής μου.
examples.translation: It was the best moment of my life.

cards.notes: Αυτή τη στιγμή = right now.

cards.definition: The first part of something; a basic rule.

examples.translation: At the beginning it was difficult.

cards.notes: Από την αρχή = from the start. Οι αρχές = the authorities.

cards.definition: Trying to do something.

examples.text: Τα κατάφερα με την πρώτη προσπάθεια.
examples.translation: I managed it on the first attempt.

cards.notes: Προσπαθώ = to try.

cards.definition: The final part of something.

examples.text: Στο τέλος του δρόμου στρίψε δεξιά.
examples.translation: At the end of the road turn right.

examples.text: Δεν είδα το τέλος της ταινίας.
examples.translation: I didn't see the end of the film.

cards.notes: Τέλος! = That's it! Τα τέλη = fees, charges.

cards.definition: The centre of something; the middle of the body.

examples.text: Στη μέση του δωματίου υπάρχει ένα τραπέζι.
examples.translation: There's a table in the middle of the room.

cards.notes: Στη μέση = in the middle.

cards.definition: A line or sequence of things; your turn to do something.

examples.text: Βλέπω μια καινούρια σειρά στην τηλεόραση.
examples.translation: I'm watching a new series on TV.

cards.notes: Με τη σειρά = in order, in turn.

cards.definition: Something that makes something else happen.

examples.text: Ποια ήταν η αιτία του ατυχήματος;
examples.translation: What was the cause of the accident?
He got angry for no reason.

cards.definition: A part of a town, country or the world.

examples.translation: I live in a quiet area.

examples.text: Η περιοχή είναι γνωστή για το κρασί της.
examples.translation: The region is known for its wine.

cards.definition: A number of people together; a sports team.

examples.translation: We work in groups of four.

cards.definition: What happens because of something; a final score.

examples.text: Ποιο ήταν το αποτέλεσμα του αγώνα;
examples.translation: What was the result of the match?
I'm waiting for my exam results.

cards.definition: A word or symbol for an amount.

examples.text: Ποιος είναι ο αριθμός του τηλεφώνου σου;

cards.notes: In everyday speech you also hear το νούμερο.

cards.definition: One of two equal parts.

examples.text: Έφαγε τα μισά και άφησε τα υπόλοιπα.
examples.translation: He ate half and left the rest.

cards.notes: Also an adjective, μισός, μισή, μισό: μισή ώρα = half an hour; δύο και μισή = half past two.

cards.definition: What you want to achieve; also a melody.

examples.text: Ποιος είναι ο σκοπός του ταξιδιού σας;
examples.translation: What's the purpose of your trip?

examples.text: Ο σκοπός μας είναι να βοηθήσουμε.

cards.definition: A part of something; also a song or track.

examples.translation: Would you like a piece of cake?

cards.definition: Two people together; two things of the same kind.

examples.text: Είναι ζευγάρι εδώ και τρία χρόνια.
examples.translation: They've been a couple for three years.
I bought a pair of shoes.

cards.definition: A place where people work; a writing table.

examples.text: Τα χαρτιά είναι πάνω στο γραφείο μου.
examples.translation: The papers are on my desk.

cards.notes: Ταξιδιωτικό γραφείο = travel agency.

cards.definition: Something you aim at or want to achieve.

examples.text: Ο στόχος μου είναι να μιλάω καλά ελληνικά.
examples.translation: My goal is to speak Greek well.

cards.definition: A place where things are sold.
cards.notes: Also used for a café, bar or restaurant. Formal: το κατάστημα.

cards.definition: A place for buying and selling; something bought.

examples.translation: I'm going to the market to do some shopping.

cards.notes: Κάνω αγορές = to go shopping. Η Αρχαία Αγορά = the Ancient Agora.

cards.definition: What something means; how much it matters.

examples.text: Ποια είναι η σημασία αυτής της λέξης;
examples.translation: What's the meaning of this word?

cards.definition: How much something costs; respect.

examples.translation: It's a great honour for me.

cards.notes: Οι τιμές ανεβαίνουν = prices are rising.

cards.definition: Money; mostly used in the plural.
cards.notes: Usually plural, τα χρήματα; more formal than τα λεφτά.

cards.definition: How things are at a particular time.

examples.text: Το αυτοκίνητο είναι σε καλή κατάσταση.
examples.translation: The car is in good condition.

cards.definition: A business that keeps and lends money.

examples.translation: I have to go to the bank.

cards.notes: Don't confuse it with το τραπέζι (table).

cards.definition: Armed fighting between countries or groups.

examples.text: Ο παππούς μου πολέμησε στον πόλεμο.
examples.translation: My grandfather fought in the war.

cards.definition: Physical strength, energy or power.

examples.text: Η δύναμη της θάλασσας είναι τεράστια.
examples.translation: The power of the sea is enormous.

cards.definition: A particular situation or example.

examples.text: Σε περίπτωση βροχής, θα μείνουμε μέσα.
examples.translation: In case of rain, we'll stay inside.

cards.notes: Σε κάθε περίπτωση = in any case.

cards.definition: All the people born around the same time.

examples.text: Η γενιά μου μεγάλωσε χωρίς κινητά.
examples.translation: My generation grew up without mobile phones.

examples.text: Το σπίτι ανήκει στην οικογένεια εδώ και τρεις γενιές.
examples.translation: The house has belonged to the family for three generations.

cards.definition: A printed or online publication with news.

examples.translation: I read the newspaper every morning.
I saw it in the newspaper.

cards.definition: Something that is true; something that happens.

examples.text: Είναι γεγονός ότι η ζωή ακρίβυνε.
examples.translation: It's a fact that life has got more expensive.

examples.text: Η τηλεόραση έδειξε τα γεγονότα ζωντανά.
examples.translation: The TV showed the events live.

cards.definition: A device showing programmes; the programmes themselves.
cards.notes: Βλέπω τηλεόραση = to watch TV.

cards.definition: A device for listening to broadcasts; broadcasting itself.

examples.translation: I listen to the radio in the car.
I heard it on the radio.

cards.definition: A group of things that are alike.

examples.translation: What kind of music do you listen to?

examples.text: Αυτό το είδος πουλιού είναι σπάνιο.
examples.translation: This species of bird is rare.

cards.notes: Τι είδους…; = What kind of…? Τα είδη = goods, items.

cards.definition: Information sent to someone.
A phone you carry with you.
cards.notes: Short for κινητό τηλέφωνο.
